resources.string: No wallpaper generated yet. Click \"Update Wallpaper Now\" to fetch your first NASA APOD image!

Follow these 4 simple steps in Projectivy Launcher:
1. Open Projectivy Settings (gear icon). 2. Select: Appearance → Wallpaper. 3. Choose "Wallpaper type" → "User Defined Folder" or "Image (slideshow)". 4. Click on the "Uri" field and enter: file:///storage/emulated/0/Pictures/AstroFrame (press Enter/OK on remote to save). 5. (Optional) Set Slideshow interval to 30 minutes to match this app!
